Smart friend


Zeek Arkham 🇺🇸 (@ZeekArkham)

Had a friend I’ve known for almost twenty years call me this morning.

He found this account and my IG. Cursed me out, called me a “coon,” said he doesn’t f**k with “MAGA supporters,” and told me not to ever contact him again. 

I hadn’t even had my coffee yet… like, bruh… let me at least be awake for this. You’re this level of mad before breakfast? 

When I started speaking up years ago, I knew I was going against the grain. I knew I’d lose friends.

These comments by @stephenasmith and @billmaher are truly idiotic. First,
@NYCMayor @ZohranKMamdani is NOT a communist. He’s a socialist. And clearly the voters felt he was more qualified than @andrewcuomo. This is all asinine commentary.


Brandon Straka #WalkAway (@BrandonStraka)

Stephen A. Smith: “Do we really think that Zohran Mamdani was the most qualified candidate to be Mayor of New York City? Come on now! We know better!”

“He had NEVER done anything.”

Bill Maher: “He’s also a communis

Republicans against Trump (@RpsAgainstTrump)
